recommendation: Keep this no-change audit as-is for the core source reconciliation. If HL7 wants to change how maturity is displayed in generated IG publications, handle that in the current IG Publisher/FMG policy workflow rather than by adding redundant core narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-18277 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core change request asking that ballot/published implementation guides expose a maturity level, because ballot reviewers could not otherwise assess how mature IGs were. The accepted resolution said FHIR has maturity for IGs and other artifacts, that HL7 published IGs should expose maturity and supporting evidence, and that FMG would set policy and timing.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by git commit 4a9568ad8d2003a8c68ca8c1d548df26d456a9a0, referenced from the Jira comment as GH#4a9568ad8d. That historical commit modified the then in-repository IG Publisher code to collect FMM extensions, add maturity values to generated profile/extension/resource lists, add maturity fragments, and render a maturity/status banner for resources. Earlier source commit 6f1d2de53ecd4a6a7d11b542402f0e3c8afdb6b2 had already updated the FMM level requirements to include FMG approval of resource/profile/IG proposals.
additional_context: The current core checkout no longer contains the old tools/java/org.hl7.fhir.igtools publisher implementation touched by 4a9568ad8d, so there is no current in-scope publisher source hunk to maintain here. The active source still defines the FHIR Maturity Model for all artifacts and explicitly includes implementation guides in the FMM 1 requirement, source/fhir.ini actively lists ImplementationGuide as a built resource with owner/security/FMM metadata, and the ImplementationGuide StructureDefinition carries standards-status and structuredefinition-fmm metadata. Related FHIR-11245 and FHIR-11247 cover extension/profile maturity support and are already represented on the combined branch by separate audit commits. Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later direct reversal or conflict for FHIR-18277.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current core specification already preserves the source needed for IG maturity interpretation, and the specific historical display mechanism was applied in publisher tooling that is no longer part of this checkout. Adding duplicate prose to the ImplementationGuide page or packages page would not change implementer understanding and would risk drifting from the central FMM policy.

Profile maturity support points back to FHIR-11245 and is already audited on the combined branch.
